titulo: On the one hand, on the other
intro: The words that give a long answer or a text a visible shape.
p.en primer lugar.consejo: It opens the text. «En segundo lugar» or «por último» follow. A comma comes after it.
p.por un lado.consejo: It almost always calls for «por otro lado». You can also say «por una parte… por otra».
p.por otro lado.consejo: It answers «por un lado». A very common synonym is «por otra parte».
p.asimismo.consejo: It is formal and written. Among friends you say «además» or «también».
p.por último.consejo: It closes a list of ideas. Do not mix it up with «en conclusión», which closes the whole text.
p.en conclusión.consejo: It sums up everything said. «En resumen» and «para terminar» are similar. A comma follows.
p.en definitiva.consejo: It closes the text with the key idea. It equals «en resumen» or «en conclusión».
p.en cuanto a.consejo: A noun follows: «en cuanto a las empresas». Synonym: «respecto a».
p.cabe destacar que.consejo: It is formal. «Cabe» comes from «caber» and is spelled with b. «Que» and a verb follow.
p.teletrabajo.consejo: It is masculine: «el teletrabajo». «Tele-» means «at a distance», as in «teléfono».
p.ventaja.consejo: It is feminine: «una ventaja». Its opposite is «desventaja». The v sounds like b.
p.inconveniente.consejo: It is masculine although it ends in -e: «un inconveniente». You often hear «ventajas e inconvenientes».
b1.texto:
At B2 level, the reader should see how your ideas are arranged. **Connectors** are the signposts.

- to begin: **en primer lugar**
- to go on: **en segundo lugar**, **a continuación**, **por último**
- to weigh two sides: **por un lado… por otro lado**
- to add: **además**, **asimismo**
- to change topic: **en cuanto a**, **respecto a**
- to underline: **cabe destacar que**
- to close: **en conclusión**, **en definitiva**

At the start of a sentence, the connector is followed by a **comma**.
b2.f0.texto: Firstly, we have to choose the topic.
b2.f2.texto: On the one hand, it offers many advantages.
b2.f3.texto: On the other hand, it also has a drawback.
b2.f4.texto: Likewise, we must mention the time saved.
b2.f5.texto: As for companies, it is worth noting that they spend less.
b2.f6.texto: Lastly, we will write a clear conclusion.
b2.f7.texto: All in all, we will finish soon.
b4.titulo: Connectors that put things in order
b4.texto:
A connector goes at the start of the sentence and is followed by a **comma**.

- **Order**: en primer lugar → en segundo lugar → por último
- **Two sides**: por un lado… por otro lado
- **Adding**: además, asimismo
- **New topic**: en cuanto a + noun
- **Closing**: en conclusión, en definitiva

If you open with **por un lado**, close the contrast with **por otro lado**: the pair stays together.
b4.e0.texto: On the one hand, working from home saves time.
b4.e1.texto: On the other hand, many people feel lonely.
b4.e2.texto: In conclusion, working from home has advantages.
b5.f0.texto: The morning light comes in through the living-room window.
b5.f1.texto: Clara puts her cup of coffee next to the computer.
b5.f2.texto: On the one hand, the silence of the house gives her a sweet calm.
b5.f3.texto: On the other hand, the lack of voices makes the hours longer.
b5.f4.texto: Outside, the wind stirs the tree's leaves with a soft murmur.
b5.f5.texto: At midday, the smell of toast fills the kitchen.
b5.f6.texto: Clara switches off the computer and breathes deeply.
b5.f7.texto: Lastly, she steps onto the balcony with an apple in her hand.
b5.f8.texto: The mild sun caresses her face.
b5.f9.texto: All in all, working from home brings her more time and more peace.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it presents the other side of the question.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It closes a list; it does not answer «por un lado».
b6.o2.refuerzo: That sums up the whole text; it does not open another side.
b7.frase: Cabe ____ que gastan menos en oficinas.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it: «cabe» takes an infinitive, «cabe destacar».
b7.o1.refuerzo: That is a participle. After «cabe» you need the infinitive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: It is conjugated. After «cabe» comes the infinitive, unconjugated.
b7.pregunta: Complete the formula to underline a fact.
b8.frase: Por un lado permite organizar mejor el día
b8.traduccion: On the one hand, it lets you organise your day better
b9.o0.refuerzo: It adds one more idea; it closes nothing.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done: it sums up the final idea of the text.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It changes the topic; it is not a closing.
b9.pregunta: Which connector is used to close a text?
b10.pregunta: Write with the accent mark: «in conclusion».
b11.frase: Por un lado, ofrece ventajas. Por ____ lado, tiene inconvenientes.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «lado» is masculine and the pair is «por otro lado».
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is feminine. «Lado» is masculine, so it does not agree.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Por último» exists, but «por último lado» does not.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Correct: it introduces what you are going to talk about now.
p.elegir.consejo: The g before e sounds like a soft h: e-le-HIR. Stress falls on the last syllable.
p.tema.consejo: It ends in -a but it is masculine: «el tema». The stress is on the first syllable.
p.ventajas.consejo: Plural of «ventaja». The v sounds like b, and the j like h.
p.mencionar.consejo: The c before i is the soft th sound in Spain: men-thyo-NAR.
p.empresas.consejo: Feminine plural of «empresa». Say the p softly, without a puff of air.
p.gastan.consejo: From «gastar», to spend. The stress falls on GAS.
p.escribiremos.consejo: Future tense of «escribir». The stress falls on RE.
p.terminaremos.consejo: Future of «terminar», to finish. Stress on RE.
p.ahorra.consejo: The h is silent. The stress falls on the second syllable: a-O-rra.
p.solas.consejo: Feminine plural of «solo», alone. Stress on SO.
p.ordenador.consejo: In Spain «ordenador» means computer; in Latin America people say «computadora».
p.regala.consejo: From «regalar», to give as a gift. Stress on GA: re-GA-la.
p.falta.consejo: «La falta de» means «the lack of». Stress on FAL.
p.cabe.consejo: From «caber», to fit. With «que» it means «it is worth» or «it is possible».
p.oficinas.consejo: Plural of «oficina». The c before i is a soft th: o-fi-THI-nas.
p.organizar.consejo: The z is pronounced th in Spain. Stress falls on the last syllable.
p.inconvenientes.consejo: Plural of «inconveniente», a drawback. It is the opposite of «ventajas».
